task:
Visit Wikipedia pages in the following sequence and create bookmarks:
1. Start at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Wide_Web
2. After the page loads, find and click the link to 'Tim Berners-Lee' on the page to navigate to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tim_Berners-Lee (the link is in the article text). Bookmark the Tim Berners-Lee page.
3. Open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CERN
4. Navigate to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTML

Create bookmarks for:
- Tim Berners-Lee page
- CERN page

When done:
- All four Wikipedia pages must appear in browsing history
- At least two tabs must be open
- The two specified bookmarks must exist

verification.description: Bookmark for Tim Berners-Lee page exists
